title: Arkret Applet Managed Device Authentication
description: RFC9421 Arkret-Managed-Device header value: base64url without padding of RFC8785 JCS of this closed object. Covered metadata is authenticated with the accepted device key; request scope is intersected with device authorization, exact installation and all business gates.

nonce.description: Independent random request nonce with at least 128 bits of entropy, signed inside the closed metadata.
